# Test fixtures

`DE_sample.txt`: 42 unmodified rows from the [GeoNames](https://www.geonames.org/) postal code
dump `DE.zip` (downloaded 2026-10-05), licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Selected PLZ:

| PLZ | Rows | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 76137, 34125 | 1 each | Single-row city PLZ (Karlsruhe, Kassel). |
| 01814 | 4 | Rural PLZ covering four villages ~7 km apart. |
| 10875 | 36 | Company PLZ with rows in Berlin and Stuttgart; the mean would be wrong. |
